column2: PAIR: ink black #16120e on circus yellow #f2c230. A troupe of stick-figure acrobats (bold, round heads, clear limbs) builds every numeral with their bodies: human pyramids, handstands, a contortionist's bowl. The poses breathe and wobble on the band's beat; someone always juggles or does a flip. Minute turn: the old formation tumbles apart in somersaults and the new one is built after :00. Hour: the big act, with the time still standing.

PAIR: aqua #7fe6ff ink on deep night water #04121c. A musical fountain show: the numerals are drawn by choreographed water jets and their falling droplets, pulsing to the music's beat, arcs sweeping and crossing, spray glittering. Minute turn: the old digit's jets drop away into splashes and new jets shoot the new digit after :00. Hour: the finale, every nozzle firing at once.

PAIR: dark LCD #43523d ink on pale mint #c7f0d8 (an old mobile-phone screen). The Snake game: each numeral is a snake forever slithering round its own path (ouroboros loops and switchbacks), eating a pellet on every beat and swallowing it down its length. Minute turn: the old snake leaves its path and slithers into the new digit's route after :00. Hour: a bigger game moment; the time always reads.

PAIR: brass #e0b048 ink on oxblood #2a0c10. Clockwork: every numeral is a train of meshing gears, racks and chains laid along its strokes, all turning, ticking forward a notch on each beat with an escapement's snap; a pendulum or balance wheel swings nearby. Minute turn: the old digit's gears disengage and roll away, new ones mesh in after :00. Hour: the whole mechanism drives a bigger automaton.

PAIR: white #f4fbff ink on teal #0e6a73. Soap bubbles: each numeral is a foam of outlined bubbles that wobble and jostle on a beat, with a wand blowing new bubbles that drift past and pop. Minute turn: the old digit's bubbles pop in a spreading chain and new ones are blown into the new digit after :00. Hour: one giant bubble swallows the time and bursts into the new hour.

PAIR: electric violet #c8a8ff ink on black #050008. A Tesla-coil lab: the numerals are crackling plasma arcs between electrodes, re-striking every frame along the strokes, flaring on every beat, a Jacob's ladder climbing nearby. Minute turn: the old digit's arcs sputter out and the new one strikes after :00. Hour: a lightning show between big coils, the time readable throughout.

PAIR: ivory #ece6d6 ink on felt green #123a22. Dominoes: each numeral is a line of standing domino tiles (pips visible), wobbling on the beat, a marble rolling and nudging them. Minute turn: the old digit topples in a chain reaction and the new one is set up after :00 (or a chain falls INTO the new digit). Hour: one huge chain runs through everything.

PAIR: hemp #d8b46a ink on sea blue #0f2a44. Sailor's ropework: each numeral is tied from rope (bowlines, figure-eights, coils), the strands always sliding through as if hauled on the beat, a little tension and slack. Minute turn: the old knot is untied and pulled away and the new one is tied after :00. Hour: a bigger show of knotwork, the time readable throughout.
